notes:
Parity release — everything the macOS 0.4.7 app does.
• AI translation: 8 providers (DeepL, Claude, OpenAI, Mistral, Ollama, Azure OpenAI, Grok, DeepSeek) with the provider chip next to search, formatted RTF output and a monthly usage meter.
• AI document summaries: new ✦ Summary inspector tab and "Summarize with AI" in the exhibit menu.
• e-Bundle exchange: export bundles with a litarbi-bundle.json manifest and import bundles from the Mac app (File → Import e-Bundle, or just drop the folder in).
• e-Signing: certificate (PAdES) signing with Windows certificate store / smartcards / .p12, "Sign exhibits" in the Bundle wizard, and Skribble SES/AES/QES for submissions.
• Transcription: audio/video to timestamped, searchable text — local-first via whisper.cpp.
• Trash with restore, automatic daily matter backups (keep 10), Undo Renumbering (Ctrl+Alt+Z).
• Deterministic date parsing (05.06.2021 is always 5 June 2021), subject/date detection in five languages.
• Word ribbon add-in now compiles and installs from inside the app (Settings → Word Add-in).
• Columns, window size, splitters and panes are remembered across restarts.
• Full German and French localization from the Mac string catalog.
